findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) exceeds 4s
findings.description: LCP of 5100ms is classified as 'poor'. Product images and hero banners take too long to render.
findings.recommendation: Implement lazy loading for product grid images, preload the hero image, and use responsive images with srcset.

findings.title: Total Blocking Time (TBT) exceeds 200ms
findings.description: TBT of 780ms blocks user interaction. Heavy JavaScript from product recommendations and chat widgets causes delays.
findings.recommendation: Defer chat widget initialization, lazy-load product recommendation engine, and code-split checkout scripts.

findings.title: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) exceeds 0.1
findings.description: CLS of 0.18 causes layout shifts during product image loading and ad insertion.
findings.recommendation: Set explicit dimensions on all product images, reserve space for ad slots, and use CSS aspect-ratio.

findings.title: Render-blocking resources on product pages
findings.description: 6 stylesheets and 4 scripts block rendering, adding 1800ms to the first paint.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS for product pages, defer non-essential scripts, and load third-party resources asynchronously.

findings.title: Image optimization opportunity
findings.description: 24 product images are not using modern formats. Converting to WebP would save approximately 1.2MB.
findings.recommendation: Implement automatic image optimization pipeline with WebP/AVIF conversion.

findings.title: Product images missing alt text
findings.description: 8 product images in the grid lack alt attributes, making them inaccessible to screen readers.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text including product name and key attributes.

findings.title: Price information not accessible to screen readers
findings.description: Product prices use custom CSS styling without proper semantic markup, making them unreadable by assistive technologies.
findings.recommendation: Use semantic HTML for prices (<span class='price' aria-label='$29.99'>) and ensure proper ARIA attributes.

findings.title: Shopping cart button not labeled
findings.description: The cart icon button has no accessible name, making it impossible for screen reader users to identify.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-label='Shopping cart (3 items)' or visible text to the cart button.

findings.title: Product pages missing structured data
findings.description: Product listing pages lack JSON-LD Product schema, missing rich snippet opportunities in search results.
findings.recommendation: Add JSON-LD Product schema with name, price, availability, and review data to all product pages.

findings.title: Product images missing descriptive filenames
findings.description: 12 product images use generic filenames like 'IMG_001.jpg' instead of descriptive names.
findings.recommendation: Rename image files to include product name and relevant keywords (e.g., 'red-cotton-tshirt.jpg').

findings.title: Third-party script performance impact
findings.description: Analytics, chat, and recommendation scripts add 1.8MB and block the main thread for 520ms.
findings.recommendation: Audit third-party scripts, defer non-essential ones, and consider self-hosting critical libraries.

findings.title: Cookie consent banner blocks content
findings.description: The cookie consent overlay covers 40% of the viewport and prevents interaction until accepted.
findings.recommendation: Move cookie consent to a non-blocking banner or bottom sheet that doesn't prevent content access.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: X-Frame-Options and X-Content-Type-Options headers are missing, increasing vulnerability to clickjacking and MIME sniffing.
findings.recommendation: Add X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers.

opportunities.title: Defer offscreen images
opportunities.description: 18 product images below the fold load eagerly, consuming bandwidth and blocking other resources.

opportunities.title: Properly size images
opportunities.description: 6 product images are served at 2x their display size on mobile.

opportunities.title: Reduce the impact of third-party code
opportunities.description: Third-party scripts (analytics, chat, recommendations) block the main thread for 520ms.

opportunities.title: Enable text compression
opportunities.description: API responses and JSON data are served without compression.
